content.text:
Are you looking for **the text**, **a summary**, or **bibliographic details** for *The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night, Volume V*?

If you mean **John Payne’s translation** titled *The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night*, **Volume V** is part of his 9-volume English translation published in the 1880s. It is available free online via sources such as Wikisource and scanned/PDF archives. Wikisource lists Payne’s edition and its volume contents. ([en.wikisource.org](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Book_of_the_Thousand_Nights_and_One_Night/Contents?utm_source=openai))

If you mean **Richard F. Burton’s similar title**, note that Burton’s work is titled *The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night* — **“a Night,” not “One Night”** — and his **Volume 5 of 10** is also available through Project Gutenberg. ([gutenberg.org](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/54257/pg54257-images.html?utm_source=openai))

**Quick distinction:**

| Title | Translator | Volumes | Common source |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| *The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night* | John Payne | 9 vols. | Wikisource / scans |
| *The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night* | Richard F. Burton | 10 vols. | Project Gutenberg |

If you want, I can provide the **table of contents of Volume V**, a **summary of its tales**, or help you find a **free readable copy**.
